BrochureContent.Content:
Rare opportunity to acquire one of the finest houses in Ratoath village. Boasting an impressive floor area of
  C. 2,900 sq.ft.   The property is presented in immaculate condition and offers comfortable family living throughout. There are three reception rooms, designer kitchen, six bedrooms, (4 en-suite), and seven bathrooms.

Although in the heart of the village, the house is sited a suitable distance from the county road and nestles into a mature well stocked garden offering a complete sense of peace and tranquillity while having all amenities adjacent.

The village is within walking distance of the property, and a host of amenities included a Super Value,  Tesco, bars, restaurants, schools,  other local recreational amenities of  Golf clubs , GAA Soccer, Tennis, Rugby clubs,  Emerald Park, Fairyhouse Racecourse , and the historic Hill of Tara

Within close proximity of the N2/N3/M50 as well as Regular Bus Eireann Services to Dublin City & Airport, Navan and also to Dundalk College
